config.world: D8 DRAFT config, values marked PROBE are candidates the probe confirms or replaces before the pilot (PREREG-D8-DRAFT.md Section 7). Forced two-dimensional turbulence, Kolmogorov forcing F0 k_f cos(k_f y) at k_f = 4 with linear drag; rankings READ (training mean |w_k|^2 s_k) against the graded controls BALL (|k|), ENSTROPHY (|w_k|^2) and KE (|w_k|^2/|k|^2), SENS recorded, RANDOM null; AOT nudging from v = 0 on fresh test trajectories over the m ladder; m* per observer, the finite-time synchronization budget (sustained below threshold over the final T_hold).
config.nu_note: FIXED 2026-10-10 by the owner from probe rounds 1-3: nu_1 = 0.03 and nu_2 = 0.02 with n = 96 as the coarser resolution (both chaotic and resolved at n = 96: Lyapunov +0.06 / +0.26, enstrophy tails 5e-10 / 1e-7); T_sync = 100, T_hold = 10 (chosen on the separation of delta: 3 of 52 graded cells ambiguous per valid world against 45 of 260 at T_sync = 50). Pilot ladder n = 96 and 128. Run ladder n = 128 and 192 by Section 2's rule (one step finer than the pilot), DECIDED by the owner 2026-10-13 with K = 8 test trajectories per world (32 cells; PREREG-D8-RUN-DRAFT.md Section 1), on NRP in the exempt class, one Job per (world, trajectory, arm), the n = 192 graded and variant arms split by ladder halves
